frontend/app/notetaker/tasks.tsx: toggle() does optimistic removal from the current list before/without re-fetching the other tab, which is correct per the spec (card simply disappears from current tab), but note it does NOT add the task into the other tab's cached list -- that's fine since the other tab is refetched on focus via useFocusEffect, but if a user toggles and switches tabs without navigating away/back, useFocusEffect still fires on tab change via setTab's dependency so this is handled correctly (load(tab) re-runs because `tab` is in the deps array of the useCallback passed to useFocusEffect).

rca_of_issue: Tooling RCA (not an app bug): across 10+ browser_automation calls targeting https://dhara-shield-2.preview.emergentagent.com (home, /notetaker, /notetaker/tasks, with/without viewport config, with/without localStorage auth pre-seeding via add_init_script, after an `sudo supervisorctl restart expo`), every single returned 'final' screenshot was byte-identical (12997 bytes, pure white) regardless of script content -- including a script whose entire purpose was to inject `document.documentElement.appendChild(fullscreen red div, z-index 2147483647)` immediately before the screenshot call, which still produced the identical pre-existing blank image. A control call to https://example.com in the same tool produced a correctly-rendered, differently-sized (44174 bytes) screenshot matching that page's real content, proving the tool itself functions correctly in general. Independently, curl against the preview URL returns HTTP 200, the Expo JS bundle downloads fully (14MB, no truncation), supervisor logs show no bundler errors, and POST /api/auth/login against the same preview URL succeeds normally outside the browser tool. Conclusion: the browser_automation tool's screenshot capture was stuck/cached for this specific preview session and did not reflect the live page at all; this blocked all planned frontend verification steps for this iteration despite the underlying app very likely being fine.
